articles.summary: – Q3 2026 Net Revenue of $863 million ; GAAP Net Loss of $22 million ; Diluted Loss per Share of $(0.06) – – Adjusted EBITDA of $207 million ; Adjusted Diluted EPS of $0.26 – – Updating 2026 Full Year Guidance – BRIDGEWATER, N.J., Nov. 03, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Amneal Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (Nasdaq: AMRX) (“Amneal” or the “Company”) today announced its results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026. “Amneal delivered another quarter of strong, broad-based performance, enabling us to increase our 2026 guidance once more. As we prepare to enter 2027, our financial performance is accelerating driven by a number of key catalysts and new launches, including Women’s Health patches, biosimilars, injectables such as lanreotide, CREXONT ® , and BREKIYA ® autoinjector. The Kashiv integration is proceeding well, and we are excited about the long-term growth potential in biosimilars. articles.title: Amneal Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
